steps.subject: sky
steps.action: lay crisscross strokes of alizarin crimson into the sky
steps.load: small amount tapped into the bristles

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add lavender with phthalo blue and crisscross
steps.load: touch picked up without cleaning the brush

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the sky with a clean dry brush

steps.subject: water
steps.action: drop in phthalo blue for the water area

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: build a small cloud with titanium white and bright red
steps.load: touch of bright red into lots of white

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: add more cloud layers with circular strokes
steps.rule: circular strokes keep clouds fluffy, not flat

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud bases gently with a clean dry brush

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: fluff the clouds in big circles and blend the sky

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: push in a dark mountain shape with lots of pressure
steps.rule: only the outside edge matters at this stage

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the paint out so it lightens toward the base
steps.rule: the wet canvas lets the paint slide and lighten

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: let a white and bright red knife roll flow down the mountain side
steps.load: small roll cut across on the knife
steps.motion: barely touch and let it flow

steps.subject: rock

steps.load: two colors loaded on the knife edge
steps.rule: paint breaking leaves holes that read as rocks and stones

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the two-color knife strokes down without pressure
steps.rule: do not overblend so the colors make their own effects

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add dark color to sharpen edges where shadows are deep

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: bring highlight white with bright red down and out

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add a shadow behind a small peak

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: push dark lavender into the base of small peaks
steps.load: roll of dark lavender from the knife edge

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: add mist with a little titanium white on the knife

steps.subject: land
steps.action: lay a dark base for the land
steps.load: little paint to load the bristles
steps.rule: dark base lets the light show later

steps.subject: water
steps.action: leave a small water gap in the land

steps.subject: land
steps.action: apply yellow tones over the dark base
steps.load: loaded from the same dirty brush

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy strokes downward
steps.load: tapped bright red in, then sap green
steps.rule: dark underneath makes light grass show up

steps.subject: water
steps.action: gently rub the water area clean

steps.subject: water
steps.action: load liquid white into titanium white for the water
steps.load: liquid white thinned into the titanium
steps.rule: liquid white thins titanium so it sticks easier

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add small floating river or pond shapes

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: dab far trees with the corner of the fan
steps.load: dark mix loaded on the fan
steps.rule: breaks up the distant patches a little

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: push a big tree shape with a bent 2in
steps.load: dark colors and blue on the brush

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: push a chisel-edge 2in into the big tree shape
steps.load: heavy load to a chisel edge
steps.rule: pushing hard drives things back and creates depth

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add trunk marks with titanium white and dark sienna

steps.subject: land
steps.action: flow van dyke brown and dark sienna land downward

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape sticks and twigs with the knife point

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: bounce the knife across to make rocks and stones
steps.load: white and dark sienna on the knife

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight the tree with liquid white and cadmium yellow
steps.load: liquid white thins the paint, black and yellow loaded
steps.motion: push and bend the brush in one direction
steps.rule: liquid white thins paint so it sticks to the thick paint

steps.subject: bush

steps.action: dab small highlights on the big tree
steps.load: bright red and indian yellow loaded lightly

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push more bushes sideways, one after another
